page.notes: Right margin note block: the small lines read "Fonsc mi-", "Fonseca", "ta.l.6 c.8 a.", "4.f.10. resp.", "ad 3. argum."; transcribed as one note at the "Petr." line. "hili" is doubtful (probably "nihil"). "facturam" and "facturam esset" are copied as best read. The catchword "lanta-" is uncertain; it probably continues the hyphenated "vo-" as "luntas".
